svg.title: Components map v3 for Aarav's startup funding pulse
svg.desc: Swimlane grid with eleven actors and six stages. Aarav forwards LinkedIn and X posts to a Telegram bot and edits his config; both are stored in Neon Postgres with four weeks of deal history. A Monday 6 AM IST Vercel cron pulls the last 7 days of news from RSS, Google News and GDELT. Gemini Flash filters, extracts and dedupes deals using Neon data and a live rupee-dollar rate from Frankfurter, and saves them back to Neon. Gemini with Google Search fact-checks focus deals, a code-only analysis engine computes watchlist matches, sector trends and new investors, and a second Gemini Flash step writes the brief. Aarav reviews the brief on the website and by email and decides what to act on.
